subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Owl and Wisdom
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Owl and Wisdom usable.

hook.text: Athena's owl watched from her shoulder. In Greece, the owl meant wisdom. Athenian coins carried its image.

buildup.text: Owls see in the dark. They fly silently. Humans who valued unseen knowledge made the owl their symbol.

discovery.text: In Hindu tradition, Lakshmi rides an owl. Wisdom and wealth share the same night-seeing creature.

twist.text: But in many cultures, owls mean death. In Mexico and parts of Africa, an owl's call predicts someone will die.

climax.text: Wisdom and death share a bird because both involve seeing what others can't. Vision in darkness defines the owl.

punchline.text: It sees what you can't. That's the point.

quiz.question: Which Greek goddess was associated with the owl?
